title: Itaú Develops Generative AI for Customers and Employees
excerpt: Brazilian bank Itaú is using generative AI across its customer base through the ia.i conversational interface and the IARA governance platform.
body_html:
Brazilian financial institution Itaú is implementing an artificial intelligence strategy across its organization, serving both its customer base and its internal workforce. Operating within a heavily regulated sector, the bank has introduced two key tools to support this initiative.

The first tool is ia.i, which functions as a conversational interface designed for users. Alongside this, the institution has established the IARA governance platform. These developments are part of the bank's broader push to integrate AI technologies into its daily operations and services.
